title: Hoshino Ichika — Waiting For Inspiration〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this sounds too muddy...
I should be able to play it much cleaner.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I think you've come a long way since you first started! Let's keep trying and get a sound that you're happy with today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember the fretting techniques we talked about! And how to move up and down the fretboard!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I tried practicing this part too, and I totally get what she means about it sounding muddy! It's so hard to smoothly move your fingers into the right places!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wait...! This attempt's going really great! If she can keep this up...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ichi, what's wrong...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ow... My finger...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your finger...? Is that blood...?! Your finger's bleeding!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no! We need the first aid kit!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got the first aid kit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I heard that you're hurt, Ichika! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku? You're here too...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was practicing by myself since I wasn't assigned to tutor anyone today. Then I heard Rin shouting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I just cut my finger a little...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, we need to clean her wound and the area around it first...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
Ichi, this is gonna sting a bit...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Let's put a bandage on it and...
There. All done!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin.
Also, Miku, sorry for causing such a big fuss.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I'm just glad that it wasn't so bad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you need to stop playing for the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Wait, I have so much time left to practice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. What if it gets worse? Also, you probably won't be able to play very well if you have to keep thinking about your cut. If anything, you may pick up some bad habits.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's right, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There are times when you can go a bit overboard and times when you really shouldn't. This is one of those times when you shouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
You're right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was sure that I would've developed calluses by now after practicing so much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Injuring myself at a time when I can't afford to... I still have a long way to go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I disagree, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For these training sessions, you're practicing at a much harder pace than usual.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's no reason to think that you haven't been doing your best until this point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with Miku-P on this one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All you gotta do is think of some things that you can do that don't involve playing your guitar.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like... Finger exercises?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That could work, but...
Gimme a second!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I'm gonna play as you, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Just watch!
Lemme see... The part you were playing just now went like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, it's that sound!
It's a lot like the muddy sound that I got when I was practicing just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been having trouble with this part too... The sound I get when I don't get it right is really similar to yours, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna try playing it in your place. That might give you some ideas as to what you can do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I can't let a little cut stop me in my tracks. If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If Rin's going to play for you, Ichika, then I'll be the tutor. Is this more or less what you wanted that part to sound like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Way to go, Miku-P!
That sounded awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It really did!
Rin, how did it sound when I played it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
The same as Miku-P for most of it.
But what separates you from her is... Oh, the timing for when you fret!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Watch me for a bit.
When you don't quite get it right, Ichi, your timing's all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I haven't seen these two practice much together before, but they seem to make a nice duo.)
